senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. בָּאַשׁ, בְּאוּשָׁה, אוּבְשִׁין, אַבְשׁוּנָא)parched, dry, withered, opp. לח moist, green.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:3">Dem. II, 3</cite> <he>לח וי׳</he> fresh or dried fruits.

<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 2:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>בי׳ שלשת קבין</he> wholesale dealing in dried fruits means three Kab. Y. ib. II, end, 23ᵃ <he>נתנו שיעור לי׳</he> for dried fruit they make quantity the standard; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְבֵשִׁים</he>, <he>יְבֵשִׁין</he>; <he>יְבֵי׳</he>.
Pes. II, 6; a. fr.—Fem. יְבֵשָׁה, יְבֵי׳.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 7:16">Tosef. Ter. VII, 16</cite> <he>נעשית י׳</he> the date became dry (so as to be called <cite ref="J00046"><he>יְבֵּישָׁה</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>יְבֵשׁוֹת</he>, <he>יְבֵי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 3:6">T’bul Yom III, 6</cite> <he>תמרים י׳</he>, opp. <he>רטובות</he>; a. fr.
